title: two independent SSE parsers in watch.rs and client.rs risk divergence
description: watch.rs parse_sse_frame and client.rs parse_sse_event are two independent implementations of the SSE frame parser. They already differ: parse_sse_frame exposes the id: field; parse_sse_event ignores it. They also have different signatures and use different intermediate types. If kithd changes its SSE wire format both parsers must be updated in sync. A single shared SSE parser in kith-core would eliminate this drift. Risk: maintainer updates one parser and forgets the other.
